title: La farmacia
goal: Explain what hurts and get something for it
culture: The pharmacist is the first line of medicine here, not the doctor. You describe the symptom across the counter and she hands you something out of a drawer, often without a prescription — which is why saying algo suave matters.

beats.good: Me duele plus the part of you. It is the sentence that gets you seen anywhere in this country, and she is where you start, not the clinic.
How long is the second half of every diagnosis here, and she will ask it before she reaches for anything.
Algo suave — something mild. Say it, or you may be handed something a good deal stronger than you wanted, over the counter, no questions asked.

beats.es: Tome esto. Cada ocho horas, con comida.
beats.good: Say the dose back. There is no printed label on what she has just tipped into a little paper bag for you.
